text:
Alice is taking a walk in her neighborhood. The neighborhood has two 24-hour convenience stores (East-Mart and West-Mart), a bank, and an ATM.

While on her walk, Alice runs into her friend Bob. Bob is hungry, so Alice offers to take him to a convenience store and buy him a snack.

In each round of this study, you will review the quickest route Alice plans to take Bob to a convenience store under the circumstances shown. You will then watch Alice begin that route and select one or more statements that would best answer Bob's question about why they are going that way.

The neighborhood map appears below. You can return to this page from the quiz if you want to review the map or these instructions.

For each statement, select True or False.

If you want to review the neighborhood map or task instructions, go back to the previous page.

queries.prompt: There is only one convenience store.
Both the bank and the ATM can give you cash.
Bob is paying for the snacks.
Alice wants to reach the store as soon as possible.
